Video–FBX agreement

P01-ACTION-01 · One independent performance · Original skeletons

Statistical equivalence not established

Observed 2D agreement for one recording. No population inference, p-values, or frame-based confidence intervals.

Agreement status: indeterminate. No justified tolerance has been fixed. Tracking and reference landmarks have measurement uncertainty.

Quality and review status: provisional

  • Tracking, boundaries, or calibration remain provisional; inspect the review evidence.
  • phase_normalized: plausible camera solutions produce materially different position errors.
  • synchronized: Source clocks and synchronization events are not verified.

Reference tracking review

Eight sampled frames; green segments have endpoint confidence ≥0.70, orange segments do not. Labels: 0: left_shoulder, 1: right_shoulder, 2: left_hip, 3: right_hip, 4: left_wrist, 5: right_wrist, 6: left_elbow, 7: right_elbow

Solutions are selected using torso fit only. The first solution gives the displayed scores; alternate supported fits expose projection ambiguity. Ranges are sensitivity bounds, not confidence intervals.
